content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Kyle Meredith's PostKyle Meredith Verified accountFebruary 4 · Shared with PublicHarrison Ford says Shrinking means so much to him that if it somehow ended his career, he’d consider it a fitting final chapter.“And if it was all over here, that would be sufficient… This is very special and it really nurtures me and makes me feel like what we’re doing has value and importance.”All reactions:376 comments3 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Justin KaiserHarrison Ford has said many times that he just wants to act. And he deeply enjoys the collaborative process, so this seems like the perfect vehicle for him. He gets to be part a talented ensemble without the cheesy 'action hero' demands.9w2Teresa Trescott HarringtonThis show touches so many important social issues it isn’t surprising that he would feel that way! It really is an incredible show. He is a talented actor and I would be very sad to see him leave! ￼ (Not just because I grew up watching him. He is one of my favorites! )3w1Cathy AugustineSometimes I watch an episode more than once just because of Harrison ford. I hope he is back next season.
